import json,pathlib,hashlib,urllib.request,urllib.error
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html/mobile/updates/native')
env=json.loads((root/'latest.json').read_text());m=json.loads(env['payload'])
apk=root/m['file']
if not apk.is_file():raise RuntimeError('native_apk_missing_on_disk')
h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
with apk.open('rb') as f:
 while True:
  c=f.read(262144)
  if not c:break
  h.update(c);size+=len(c)
if h.hexdigest()!=m['sha256'] or size!=m['size']:raise RuntimeError('native_apk_disk_digest_mismatch')
url='https://app.ontrackegy.com/mobile/updates/native/'+m['file']
req=urllib.request.Request(url,method='HEAD',headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache','User-Agent':'OnTrack-OTA-Publish-Verify'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as resp:status=resp.status;ct=resp.headers.get('Content-Type','');cl=resp.headers.get('Content-Length','')
if status!=200 or int(cl)!=size:raise RuntimeError('native_apk_public_http_mismatch')
print(json.dumps({'status':'VERIFIED','version':m['version_name'],'version_code':m['version_code'],'sha256':m['sha256'],'bytes':size,'http_status':status,'http_content_type':ct,'download_url':url}))
